title: Amaya Tunic - Pink & White Embroidered

title: Amravati Top - Grey & Gold Printed
description: Ethereal and light, the Amravati Top is designed to celebrate tradition with a modern twist. Its soft grey base glows softly with gold accents, creating a piece that is equally suited for intimate gatherings or day-to-evening festivities.
one_liner: A relaxed, airy piece that adds subtle metallic texture and a vibrant color-pop accent to slim bottoms.

title: Baggy Sweater - Chartreuse
description: The Baggy Sweater leans into winter with a burst of chartreuse — bold, bright, and full of personality, the kind of colour that wakes up even the greyest day. title: Basic T-Shirt - Blush Pink

avoid: heavy layering pieces with clashing textures

title: Berber Wrap Top - Red Stripes
description: The Berber Wrap Top is inspired by our travels to Morocco. Stripes are a key element in Moroccan culture, seen in art, architecture, and textiles. The wrap and A-line silhouette gives this piece a beautiful, effortless fall.
one_liner: A lightweight wrap top that defines the waist with an A-line silhouette for a fluid, structured drape.

title: Blooming Sweater - Fuchsia & Red
description: The Blooming Sweater lives up to its name, bringing a bold fuchsia-and-red memory back to life in a fresh, modern way. Crafted in 100% organic cotton yarn and finished with a statement chrysanthemum blooming across the front and back, with a tiny pixelated navy heart as a clever nod to the past.

title: Boribo Highland Kurta - Beige
description: Elevate your summer wardrobe with a touch of contemporary style through this kurta, inspired by the captivating botanicals of Cambodia and the natural palettes found within the historic Angkor Wat temples. Tailored with practicality in mind, this kurta features built-in pockets, seamlessly combining functionality with fashion.
one_liner: A breathable, relaxed-fit tunic that balances cultural heritage motifs with practical daily functionality.

title: Boxed High Neck Sweater - Oatmeal
description: Straight out of Alice's dreams is this iconic sweater with boxes. This quirky yet sophisticated high-neck sweater is perfect for adding a streak of understated coolness to your winter outfit. Crafted in 100% organic cotton, this classic favourite goes as well under a chic jacket and on its own, why hide, anyway?
one_liner: A versatile knit base layer providing textural depth while balancing structured outerwear with its clean relaxed silhouette.

title: Boxy Shirt - Purple & Gold Embroidered
description: A modern classic, designed to move seamlessly from AM to PM. This boxy shirt's rich purple base is adorned with oversized gold flower buta embroidery, each motif thoughtfully placed to mirror across the front panels for a harmonious look. Crafted in a luxurious cotton-silk chanderi. A concealed placket is secured with subtle tacking.

title: Bramble Top - Black & Fuchsia

Crafted in fluid Bemberg, it’s finished with a delicate flower appliqué and a tie-up neckline that adds an easy, feminine lift. A light, expressive piece that moves beautifully and brings a touch of colour to cooler days.
one_liner: Soft floral print top that adds depth and movement to structured trousers or denim silhouettes.

title: Camber Top - Chocolate Brown & Gold Printed
description: The Camber Top blends classic sophistication with festive warmth, featuring rich chocolate brown and shimmering gold florals that make it perfect for any celebration. one_liner: Provides a relaxed draped silhouette, balancing festive gold-foil detailing with a grounded, versatile neutral base.

title: Camisole Top - Magenta

title: Celestial Blouse - Grey

title: Ceylon Shirt - Chocolate Brown & Gold Stripes

one_liner: Adds metallic textural dimension to evening separates with its subtle shimmer and refined embroidery details.

title: Cherai Kurta - Yellow Embroidered

Gold gota traces the hem and blooms across the bodice, sleeves, and back, catching light like flickers on water.

title: Cosy Turtle Neck Sweater - Oatmeal
description: The Cosy Turtle Neck Sweater does exactly what it says on the box - keeps you snug and looking as good as you feel. The turtle neck keeps you warm while adding a touch of elegance.

title: Demi Moon Ruffle Top - Yellow & Silver

title: Dream High-low Hem Sweater - Purple

title: Drop Armhole Shirt - Chocolate Plum

title: Peng Top - Black & Red
description: The rich culture of Thailand is the inspiration behind the Peng top. The beautiful bold print of small red roses against a black background makes it a perfect fit for evening drinks or a simple get together with the girls. Crafted in Bemberg. Bemberg is extremely breathable and perfect all year around. The fabric is biodegradable as well.
one_liner: A fluid camisole that provides a romantic floral focal point for tailored evening or festive ensembles.

title: Pintuck Pheran - Black & Gold Print
description: The Pintuck Pheran's design is inspired by our travels to Morocco. Sparkling foiled gold moons and stars come alive on a black background, making this piece a must-have in your wardrobe. Crafted in cotton, this pheran will leave you feeling light as air. Dress this piece up or down for your everyday or celebrations alike.
one_liner: A voluminous, flowy tunic that balances loose proportions with vertical pintuck detailing for an elongated silhouette.

title: Polka Jumper - Olive & Oatmeal Polkas
description: An olive green design featuring bold polka dots in oatmeal, this Polka Jumper is made for cold days and cosy get-togethers. Stay warm with layers of 100% organic cotton yarn. Oatmeal polkas add a pop of frolic to your look. The reversible style lets you wear it inside or out.

title: Pounce Sweater - Ivory & Purple
description: The Pounce Sweater strikes a bold contrast, pairing ivory and purple in a colour-blocked palette that feels crisp, confident, and distinctly Retro. Knitted in 100% organic cotton yarn, it features clean contrast borders and a purple tiger motif prowling across the left front and back, finished with our signature star at the back.
one_liner: A graphic knit piece that functions as a focal point, grounding neutral staples with bold contrast blocking.

title: Raglan Blouse - Oak Brown
description: The Raglan blouse offers an effortless and comfortable look, making you wish you could wear it every day. This blouse is crafted from Bemberg, a breathable material suitable for year-round wear. What's more, it's environmentally friendly, being biodegradable. Don't miss the charming gold foil star print detail located just below the neckline of the blouse.
one_liner: A fluid, muted-tone raglan piece that balances loose volume with structured cuffs for versatile daily layering.

title: Raven V-Neck Top - Black & Gold Print
description: Sparkling gold moons and stars come alive on a raven black background, making this piece a must-have in your wardrobe. Crafted in cotton silk, this top will leave you feeling light as air. Dress this piece up or down for your everyday or celebrations alike.

title: Ren Top - White Print
description: The Ren Top in white is a breezy addition to any wardrobe, crafted from 100% organic cotton for a lightweight, breathable feel. Soft clouds float across it while the inside features contrasting aqua stripes. Spot a delicate bullion knot rose embroidery at the side. Dress this piece up or down for effortless style to throw on and go.
one_liner: A structural wrap-front top providing visual interest through asymmetrical draping while maintaining a clean minimalist aesthetic.

title: Renai Top - Green
description: In a rich green tone, the Renai Top turns heads and enhances the overall look of your outfit. The first two buttons on the centre front placket are strategically placed to showcase the intricate craftsmanship, adding a hint of refinement to your look. Plus, look out for the colourful selvedge at the centre back and on the placket.

title: Roh Top - Orange Printed
description: The Roh Top brings Sindhu’s energy into full colour, where bright orange feels like sun on water and prints drift like river flora. Made in 100% organic cotton voile, it features a ditsy ice twig print on an orange base, light, breathable, and perfect for summer.

title: Ronnie Round Neck Sweater - Oatmeal
description: Designed to feel like a warm hug, the Ronnie Round Neck Sweater is the epitome of Retro winter wear - chunky, relaxed, and eye-catching. Layers of 100% organic cotton yarn in oatmeal keep you feeling toasty warm. A dark red star adorns the front for a bold pop of colour.

title: Ruffle Top - Multi
description: Tackle any sort of outing with our Ruffle Top. Striped and multi coloured, there’s something romantic about this one. With its ruffle sleeves and elegant neckline, it’ll take you from the boardroom to the dance floor without breaking a sweat. Crafted in cupro modal, the Ruffle Top is multi coloured and has a relaxed fit. Best paired with solids to balance the print of the top.
one_liner: The empire waist and flared sleeves create a dramatic, fluid silhouette balanced by a structured bottom.

title: Saanjh Blouse - Red & Green Embroidered
description: Timeless pieces reimagined for the people who make weddings the joyful chaos that they are. This blouse is the one you'll be dancing in for years to come. The Saanjh Blouse is a vibrant red and green chintz piece in 100% organic cotton voile, featuring all-over fuchshia and yellow sequin embroidery with accents of gold and finished with tassels at the ends of the dori.

title: Sara Kurta - Oak Brown Foil Print
description: The Sara Kurta features foiled Chintamani dots against an oak brown background to symbolize the cultural connection between Morocco, where they're found in tapestries and carpets, and India, where they are rooted in mythology and folklore. Crafted in cotton silk, the fit and flare silhouette gives it a refined look.

title: Shimaz Camisole - Ivory Hand Embroidered
description: A dreamy collection infused with heritage and opulence, the Shimaz Camisole is a sheer delight in ivory with hand embroidered poppies, the perfect layering piece. The camisole floats lighter than air, crafted in a mix of cupro modal. The soft, neutral palette of ivory accentuates the intricate craftsmanship of the embroidery, creating a harmonious interplay of texture and tone.

title: Short Sleeve Kurta - Blue & White

one_liner: A versatile long-line tunic providing structured coverage that pairs best with clean-cut wide-leg trousers.

title: Sitara Blouse - Navy & Red Print

This blouse pairs with the saris from our Morocco collection

title: Strappy Back Gathered Top - Teal & Fuchsia Print

title: Strappy Blouse - Black

title: Sukoon Angrakha - Ivory

title: Tao Turtle Neck Sweater - Bright Red & Orange

title: Tranquila Camisole - Ivory & Black

Comes with a fully lined trim, and features 3 buttons on each sleeve Plus, details matter to us and so: a saddle-stitched star on one of the sleeves is our way to add whimsy This is an all-occasion piece that you'll wear…
one_liner: A versatile structural layer that transitions between closed bandhgala formality and open jacket layering.

description: Our token to tradition in our menswear collection, this nehru jacket is crafted in comfortable cotton linen. Crafted in linen cotton, this one is a no-brainer. The lining has a beautiful print of red and ivory bold flower. Find the second button on the placket in red.

description: Our token to tradition in our menswear collection, this nehru jacket is crafted in comfortable cotton linen. This Nehru jacket features a bold red rose print against a black background. Crafted in linen cotton, this one is a no-brainer. The lining has a beautiful print of elephants. Find the second button on the placket in red.
one_liner: A structured sleeveless layer that introduces floral focal points to formal monochromatic ethnic or fusion outfits.

title: Nehru Jacket - Magenta & Silver Embroidered
description: Our token to tradition in our menswear collection, this Nehru jacket is crafted in comfortable cotton linen. This Nehru jacket features dotted golden zari embroidery against a magenta background. Crafted in cotton linen, this one is a blend of style and comfort.
one_liner: Adds a structured, ceremonial layer to traditional kurtas or crisp shirts for significant cultural events.

title: Nehru Jacket - Red & Oak Brown Print
description: Our token to tradition in our menswear collection, this Nehru jacket is crafted in comfortable cotton linen and features red and brown stripes, inspired by our travels to Morocco. Stripes are a key element in Moroccan culture, seen in art, architecture, and textiles. Each striped pattern varies in width, color, and arrangement, carrying its own significance.
one_liner: Structured layering piece that adds visual interest and ethnic refinement to standard kurta or shirt outfits.

title: Rayh Shacket - Cotton Twill Relaxed fit
description: The layer you'll throw on more often than you expect, somewhere between a shirt and a jacket, and every bit as versatile. Structured cotton twill gives it substance without feeling heavy, making it the perfect companion through changing weather. Wear it open over a tee or buttoned up on cooler days.
one_liner: Versatile layering piece that adds structure to casual outfits without heavy bulk.

title: Saaj Nehru Jacket - Dark Navy
description: A dark navy that feels timeless, steady, and quietly confident. Crafted in cotton satin with a soft sheen that catches light just enough. Unembellished and precise, it adds depth without distraction. Cut in a slim fit that sharpens any look instantly. An easy layer for weddings where you want to look considered, not overdone.
one_liner: A structured sleeveless layer that brings formal coherence and visual depth to traditional or semi-formal outfits.

title: Safar Bomber - Rust
description: The Safar Bomber in rust is the ultimate blend of warmth and style. Made from 100% cotton corduroy in a rich shade of rust, this bomber offers a soft yet sturdy feel. The trim fabric lining adds a refined touch, while the subtle paw embroidery in grey at the center back brings a unique, nature-inspired detail. Perfect for layering, this bomber makes a statement its effortlessly cool look.
one_liner: A structured transitional layering piece that adds warmth and chromatic impact to layered outfits.

title: Sambar Shacket - Denim
description: The Sambar is what that looks like. 100% cotton denim in mid blue. Tight in weave, firm in weight, the kind of denim that holds its structure through the shoulder and only softens with wear. The reference is the ubiquitous safari suit of the 1970s, harking back to the golden age of travel. Redrawn for now. Safari patch pockets, front and close at hand. Detail that earns its place. Regular fit.
one_liner: A structured denim layer adding utility-inspired texture to light knitwear or crisp shirting for transitional weather.

title: Short Bandhgala Jacket - Black
description: Our token to tradition in our menswear collection, this Nehru jacket is crafted in comfortable cotton linen. This Short Bandhgala Jacket makes a statement in its classic navy, pairing seamlessly with other hues. Crafted in cotton linen, this one is a blend of style and comfort.
one_liner: A structured layering piece that bridges traditional ethnic attire with modern formal tailoring for refined silhouettes.

title: Tahr Bandhgala - Beige
description: The Tahr Bandhgala is the result. 100% linen in natural beige. No shoulder pads, half-lined with block print fabric. The kind of piece that doesn't announce itself. The bandhgala collar: a stand collar, no lapels, close to the neck. Structure at the front, ease through the body. Regimental in form, entirely relaxed in feeling. Deconstructed at every seam.
one_liner: A deconstructed linen bandhgala that anchors ethnic formal ensembles with a slim, clean-lined tailored silhouette.

title: Utility Jacket - Olive
description: Designed for the outdoors, built for the everyday—this jacket layers easily through shifting terrain. Blending the calm of the desert with the wild spirit of the jungle, Safar is a collection designed for exploration—capturing the journey within, before it even begins. Made from 100% cotton in a solid olive hue, with roomy pockets for all your trail-side finds.
one_liner: A versatile transitional layer that adds a rugged, functional structure to casual weekend ensembles.

title: Woollen Knotch Collar Jacket - Black & Grey
description: Layer up: Swap boring blazers for this classic check collar jacket Made in 55% recycled wool, 20% recycled polyester, and 25% others Detailed with a red star embroidery at the back This one pairs perfectly with most pairs of trousers and jeans that you may already own, and goes from desk to dinner and beyond Structured, with a zip front, wide lapel collar, and long sleeves
one_liner: Provides structure as a top layer for transitional weather, replacing traditional blazers with a cleaner utility aesthetic.

title: Berber Laptop Sleeve 15" - Blue
description: Cotton canvas, leather, and cotton sheeting give the sleeve structure and softness, built to carry your laptop and the rest of your working day. Slip it into a larger bag for office days, or carry it on its own with tailored separates at the desk and a linen shirt for travel mornings.
one_liner: Provides protected organization for electronics while adding a whimsical graphic accent to a professional or travel wardrobe.

title: Matchbox Laptop Sleeve - Multicolor
description: A graphic take on an everyday essential. The Matchbox Laptop Sleeve brings together bold prints inspired by traditional Indian matchbox art. Crafted in cotton canvas with a soft lining, it offers structure on the outside and ease within. Reimagined with the signature motifs, the multicolour print feels playful yet considered.
one_liner: Serves as a vivid functional accessory that protects tech essentials while acting as a standalone document portfolio.

title: Nilambari Pouch - Ivory
description: Designed to keep everyday essentials together, the Nilambari Pouch pairs thoughtful organisation with expressive print. Crafted in printed fabric, it's finished with a durable zipper and a leather puller for everyday ease. Sized to hold everything from cosmetics to travel necessities, it slips neatly into your handbag or weekend tote.
one_liner: compact zippered storage solution for organizing cosmetics and travel essentials within larger bags and everyday totes.

title: Paper Tote
description: Crafted in durable (and innovative) paper, our totes are sturdy and spacious Take them to the gym or carry them to office; either ways you're doing it right.
one_liner: A lightweight, structural carry-all providing a grounded, organic texture contrast to casual everyday outfits.

title: Stripe Bag - Ivory & Black
description: Striped and classic, this monochrome bag is crafted in 100% organic cotton and stores all your essentials. Take this bag far and wide, the classic design completes any outfit. A fun accessory to enliven any outfit.
one_liner: Provides a relaxed, graphic textural contrast to soft knitwear or monochromatic base layers.

title: The Mini Messenger - Camo Print
description: The Mini Messenger packs a punch with its cool camo print. Perfect for when you're on the go. The leather handle color and webbing straps complement the design, fiinished with plain snap buttons adding a sleek, understated touch.
one_liner: A compact utilitarian carryall that grounds relaxed weekend outfits with a functional tactical edge.

title: Tiled Laptop Sleeve - Brown & Mulberry
description: The Tiled Laptop Sleeve brings a checked, quilted finish to your everyday carry, with elephant embroidery in the corner. Made in voile with a screen-printed check, it is finished with a gold-foil leather label and a snap closure. An easy companion for the office, co-working days, or travel.
one_liner: A functional protective sleeve that adds a soft, textured pop of color to professional carry.

title: Aero Cap - Brown & Beige
description: Easy to wear and made for days on the move, the Aero Cap is a thoughtful companion for everyday adventures. Crafted in cotton twill with an aeroplane embroidery in red thread, it's finished with embroidered eyelets and an adjustable metal buckle that lets you find your perfect fit. Its clean design makes it an easy addition to everything from weekend outings to everyday errands.
one_liner: A practical utility staple providing a relaxed finishing touch to casual and athletic-inspired daily ensembles.

title: Heart Beanie - Black & Red
description: Keep cosy and snug with the Heart Beanie, in a palette of black and red with a heart on it. A fun accessory to enliven any outfit.
one_liner: Provides a cozy, playful accent to winter outerwear while adding a subtle pop of graphic color contrast.

title: Jalsa Scarf - Ivory & Grey
description: The Jalsa scarf in sophisticated and seamlessly-blending ivory & grey is the perfect neutral all-season, all-gender accessory. Whether it's layering up for an adventure or adding a pop of colour to your daily ensemble, this scarf is your year-round style companion. The handloom cotton fabric offers a soft and breathable texture, providing comfort throughout the day.
one_liner: A versatile neutral layer that softens sharp necklines and adds textural interest to simple everyday ensembles.
